headline: SoftBank -15%, Kospi near -6%, Nasdaq futures lower on tariff reports, PCE at 8:30
stance: Tech selling resumed in Asia overnight and Nasdaq futures are lower on tariff reports. PCE and GDP land at 8:30, before the Thanksgiving close.

news.head: SoftBank -15% in Tokyo
news.body: Tech shares fell globally on renewed worries over AI spending (~4:42am ET).

news.head: Dell beats, raises outlook, adds $25bn buyback
news.body: Q3 sales more than doubled on AI server demand. Reported after Tuesday's close (~5:07pm ET).

news.head: HPE -17% Tuesday, worst day in its history
news.body: Fell despite its fastest growth ever and a raised forecast (~3:23pm ET).

news.head: Anthropic below its $83 IPO price for the first time
news.body: Less than a week after its Nasdaq debut (~4:46pm ET Tuesday).

implications: Tariff reports land two weeks before the Dec 9 FOMC, with a hike close to fully expected. Higher tariffs would add to goods prices.
Japan may skip new deficit bonds, per local media (~12:20am ET). Less JGB supply would ease pressure on the yen near 159.

watch.head: PCE, GDP, durable goods and jobless claims, 8:30
watch.body: Personal income, spending and PCE prices, plus the GDP estimate and weekly claims.

watch.head: New home sales, 10:00
watch.body: Contracts on newly built homes, the most rate-sensitive part of housing.

watch.head: EUR/USD option expiries, 10:00 cut
watch.body: Strikes at 1.0900 and 1.0950 sit either side of spot (~1:37am ET).

watch.head: FOMC, Dec 9, 2:00
watch.body: Rate decision and projections. Press conference at 2:30.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Reports say the US is preparing to raise tariffs on China and others back to 2025 levels (~3:28am ET).
Treasury yields lower overnight ahead of PCE and GDP (~2:44am ET).
Iran says two more tankers hit mines in Hormuz (~4:30am ET). Crude still fell in early Asian trade (~12:50am ET).
sections.positioning: Soybeans at the 89th percentile of three years, a new extreme in the last three sessions.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Selling stayed in tech: Nasdaq 100 fell Tuesday while the Dow and Russell 2000 rose.
Nasdaq futures lower on the tariff reports (~4:45am ET). Kospi fell nearly 6% overnight (~9:56pm ET Tuesday).
Europe opened higher despite Asia: CAC 40 +0.9%, DAX +0.1% (~3:27am ET).
sections.positioning: Speculators long Russell 2000 futures at the 100th percentile of three years, unchanged for eight weeks.

single_name.note: New to the screen today, score 4. Three insider-buy rules fired; latest filing Nov 16. Trades above its 200-day line.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HY OAS retraced 13bp Monday of the 56bp widening since Nov 12.
Lenders getting pickier on Big Tech bonds that fund the AI build-out (~1:29am ET).
CP spread more than doubled in the week to Nov 20, to 53bp. SOFR-OIS still 4bp.
sections.positioning: Primary-dealer IG bond inventory at the 78th percentile of its three-year range.

ideas.line: -0.04% since Aug 13 vs S&P 500 -2.50% · to Nov 24 close · 3 open
